description_en: Describes the syntax and examples for the CompareFaceWithMask operation in the facebody category
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的口罩人脸比对1:1CompareFaceWithMask的语法及示例
name: CompareFaceWithMask

parameters.help_en: The URL of Image A. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS URLs in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像A的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url_a

parameters.help_en: The URL of Image B. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS URLs in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像B的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url_b

parameters.help_en: The quality score threshold. The system analyzes and evaluates the quality of the face images. If the quality score of a face is less than this threshold, a MessageTips description is added to the response
parameters.help_zh: 质量分阈值，对人脸图片进行质量分析判断，若某张人脸质量分小于该阈值，则会在返回结果上增加MessageTips说明
parameters.name: quality_score_threshold

Confidence.description_en: The confidence score that the largest faces in the two images belong to the same person. Valid values: 0 to 100. The three reference thresholds are 61, 69, and 75, which correspond to false acceptance rates (FARs) of 1/1,000, 1/10,000, and 1/100,000, respectively. A higher threshold indicates a lower FAR and a lower pass rate. For scenarios with higher security requirements, set a higher threshold. If no face is detected in an image, an error message is returned
Confidence.description_zh: 两张图片中的最大人脸属于同一个人的置信度，取值范围0~100。供参考的三个阈值是61，69，75分别对应千分之一，万分之一和十万分之一误识率。阈值设置越高，误识率越低，通过率也越低，对安全性要求越高的场合，可以设置更高的阈值。如果某张图片中没有人脸则报错误信息

MessageTips.description_en:
The prompt message in plain text. The following prompt messages may appear individually or in combination.
Quality-related prompts (appear when the quality score of a face is less than the quality score threshold specified in the request parameters):

`imageA quality score less threshold`: The quality score of Image A is less than the threshold specified in the input parameters.
`imageB quality score less threshold`: The quality score of Image B is less than the threshold specified in the input parameters.

Face size-related prompts (appear when a face is detected but its width or height is less than 50 pixels. When this prompt appears, provide a face with a pixel size greater than 64 × 64 if possible, and refer to the returned Confidence value as appropriate):

`face in imageA is too small`: The face in Image A is too small.
`face in imageB is too small`: The face in Image B is too small
MessageTips.description_zh:
提示信息，纯文字描述，以下提示信息单独出现或是几条提示信息的组合。
质量相关提示（某张人脸质量分小于请求参数质量分阈值时会出现）：

`imageA quality score less threshold`：图像A的质量分小于输入参数设置的阈值。
`imageB quality score less threshold`：图像B的质量分小于输入参数设置的阈值。

人脸尺寸相关提示（检测到人脸且人脸宽或高小于50像素时会有该提示信息。出现该提示信息时，请尽可能输入像素数大于64x64的人脸，并请酌情参考返回的对比置信度Confidence值）：

`face in imageA is too small`：图像A中的人脸太小。
`face in imageB is too small`：图像B中的人脸太小

items.description_en: The confidence thresholds corresponding to FARs of 1/1,000, 1/10,000, and 1/100,000. For example, `[61.0,69.0,75.0]` indicates that if the FAR is 1/1,000, a confidence score greater than 61% means the two faces belong to the same person
